drafts.label: What are you building?
drafts.answer: A shared space that helps a group turn a conversation into an organized set of ideas and next steps.

drafts.label: Who does it help?
drafts.answer: Small teams who want to stay present in a conversation and return to what matters afterward.

drafts.label: How does it use Meta tooling?
drafts.answer: Meta models help organize contributions into topics. Confirm the exact model names and demonstrated capabilities before submission.
